info.title: Acessilia Toolbox
info.description:
Deterministic, stateless capability layer for agentic systems.

Capabilities describe what can be done; providers implement it. The toolbox
executes and normalizes, while goals, planning and provider choice stay with
the agentic core.

schema.description: OpenAI chat-completions request, relayed as is except for model

200.description: The server's chat completion, relayed as is; server-sent events when the body sets stream

400.description: Invalid body, or the provider is not an OpenAI-compatible VLM

502.description: The model server rejected the Toolbox's own key

504.description: No free slot within slot_wait_seconds, or no answer within timeout_seconds

499.description: The client disconnected; it never sees this status

get.description:
Probe the VLM providers this gateway relays to.

A Toolbox whose ``qwen3-vl-8b`` points at another Toolbox's gateway
(``{endpoint}/v1/vlm``) checks its health here: the provider probes
``{endpoint}/health``, which is this route.

503.description: A VLM provider does not answer
